head: pūjay
target: rtag tu mchod bya zhes pa dus thams cad du gtsang ba'am mi gtsang ba'am langs pa'am 'dug pa'am gnyid log pa'am lus dang ngag dang sems bya ba la gnas pa na/ nang du ni nyin zhag so so'i dus kyi khyad par te/ mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba la rjes su chags pa phyi rol gyi 'dod pa thams cad la nye bar longs spyod pa'i dga' ba dang bral ba mchog gi dbang po rnams kyis mthong ba'i yul nye bar longs spyod pa la ma chags pa'o zhes pa dbu ma'i dbugs kyi rigs ldan ma mchod pa'i cho ga / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bden pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub kyi don du bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'o/ /

target: de nas srang gi 'pho ba la skyed mos tshal du dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ gshin rje mche ba ma la mchod yon phul nas lA ma la brjod pa'i bgrang phreng dang cho gas zla ba phyed dang bcas pa'i 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas pa bya zhing phyed dang bcas pa'i khri phrag bzhi sbyin sreg bya ste/ de nas mchu'i zla ba'i gnam stong la ri sul lam pad+ma'i mtsho 'gram du dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ dpa' bo'i blo can ma la mchod yon phul nas gzugs can ma la brjod pa'i bgrang phreng gis phyogs gcig la phyed dang bcas pa'i 'bum phrag bzlas shing khri phrag phyed dang bcas pa'i sbyin sreg bya ste/ oM k+Sho b+ha ya k+Sho b+ha ya badzra bI ra ma ti badzra su bai ri huM hUM phaT ces pa rkang pa lnga pa'i sngags yi ge nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ /
src_sentence: tatas tulāsaṁkrāntāv udyāne maṁḍa- laṁ vartayitvā yamadaṁşṭriṇyā arghaṁ datvā lāmoktākṣa- sūtrakrameņa sārdhamāsena sārdhacatvāri lakṣāṇi japet sārdhaca- tvāryayutāni homayet |

target: de ltar dus kyi khyad par gyis thun mtshams bzhi'i dbye ba dang / thun brgyad kyi dbye ba dang / phyogs nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dbye bas rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa drug po rnams kyis longs spyod pa dang thim pa dang dbang byed pa dang bdag po zhes pa thams cad nges pa'o/ / de ltar nyin mtshan gyis zhes pa'o/ /
src_sentence: evaṁ kālaviśeṣeņa catuḥsaṁdhyābhedenāstapraharabhedena caturviṁśati- pakṣabhedena ṣattrimśadyoginīnāṁ kālaviśeṣeņa bhogalayādhikārā ādhipatyaṁ ceti sarvatra niyamaḥ ||

src_sentence: tataḥ karkatoḍaye padmasare kuñjavan maṁḍalaṁ vartayitvā yamadādhyā arghaṁ datvā rūpiṇyoktākṣasūtravidhinā sārdhamāsena sārdhacatvāri lakṣāṇi japed daśāṁśena homayet |

target: de nas rgyal gyi zla ba'i gnam stong la ri bor dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'od ldan ma la mchod yon phul nas dum skyes ma la brjod pa'i bgrang phreng gis tshes bco lnga rnams kyis phyed dang bcas pa'i 'bum phrag bzlas shing phyed dang bcas pa'i khri phrag sbyin sreg bya'o/ / oM ban+d+ha ban+d+ha badzra pra b+hA wa ti badzra kaM ka la huM hUM phaT ces pa rkang pa gsum pa'i sngags yi ge bcu dgu pa'o/ / de ltar nyin zhag bco lngas sngags 'bum phrag phyed dang bcas pa bzlas par bya zhing sbyin sreg khri phrag phyed dang bcas pa bya ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la brjod pa'i bgrang phreng gis so sor sngags khri phrag lnga bzlas pa ni/ oM dz+nyauM dz+nyauM badzra kha gA na ne badzra bi rU pAk+Sha huM hUM phaT ces pa rkang pa bcu drug pa'i sngags yi ge bco brgyad pa'o/ / de nas gro zhun gyi zla ba'i gnam stong la rab gtum ma la brjod pa'i cho gas 'khor lo'i shugs can ma la mchod yon phul nas sngags bzla zhing sbyin sreg bya'o/ /
